value.rationale: The recent primary paper explicitly poses and estimates medialization for Conj(G), with only S3 analyzed. Full operation and automorphism-group formulas for every Sn, and complete dihedral operation normal forms, determine natural structural invariants for infinite families, not arbitrary parameter slices. The derivation exhibits a concise parity/derived-conjugacy mechanism enabling comparison without enumerating huge groups; intrinsic relevance stands even though foundational ingredients are classical.
